task: Make interactive `codemie setup assistants` warn about and unregister stale registered assistants that 404, keeping strict failure for new selections and headless mode and naming the failing assistant id in errors.

key_reasoning.reason: Data fetcher (fetchAssistantsByIds) and interactive setupAssistants orchestration, plus MESSAGES constants; downstream determineChanges/applyChanges unregister machinery is reused unchanged.

Core behaviour is defined, but 'unregister (or offer to)' is an open UX choice, the 'pass loaded assistants instead of []' goal is largely infeasible per analysis (config-derived AssistantBase rows), and cross-scope merged registrations leave stale-entry persistence in the other scope unresolved.

Closest pattern is skills fetchSkillsByIds mapping NotFoundError to RegistrationItemNotFoundError(kind, id) — direct precedent, so base S. Bumped to M: AC enumerates variant cases (registered-stale vs new selection vs headless) and the interactive setupAssistants flow has no test template; one existing test is coupled to the raw error message.
About 4 modified (data.ts, index.ts, constants.ts, data.test.ts) plus 0-1 new interactive test file; skills parallel fix is out of scope (note only).
